**Where this starts (honesty):** my A24/A25/A26 session artifacts were produced on a local tree lost to a sandbox recycle before any push. This wave re-established everything on real main:

1. **A24 recovery**: the #557 §8 patch is byte-exact (116,642 B, sha16 `bc86cdb3ec600d2d`) — I recovered it from THIS issue's comments, re-applied onto `origin/main` `d3a8d0ec` (S188 W5): `git apply --reject` → 16/17 dalvik_engine hunks + all gl_surface_shadow/dlopen_exec hunks CLEAN; 2 rejects resolved and documented (`.gitignore` context shift — `tools/native_host` appended; one diagnostics-only INVOKE-TRACE arg-value hunk SKIPPED because its anchor block does not exist on S188 W5 — no behavioral law lost). **Three new generic laws, each proven by androguard DEX truth before coding:**

| Law | DEX truth (androguard disassembly) | False answer it kills | Live face |
|---|---|---|---|
| **F-NEW-588** heap-String replace family (`replaceAll`/`replaceFirst`/`replace` CS+CC/`matches`/`contains`; real regex semantics, `\Q..\E` honored; inline-STRING_REF + heap-OBJECT receiver forms) | libGDX 1.9.10 `AssetDescriptor.<init>` i3: `String;->replaceAll(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)` | typed-default stub answered **NULL** → preloadQueue `desc.fileName.equals` NPE (`AssetManager.load` i20) → onCreate death | `i18n/TicTacToe` real filenames |

| **F-NEW-590** `Future.isDone/isCancelled` (W3 contract: inline-run → a minted box is complete at submit) | `AsyncResult.isDone()` → `Future.isDone()` polled by `AssetManager.updateTask` | no handler → **false forever** → `finishLoading` F084 50001-visit infinite-loop halt (PC=0x7) → VirtualMachineError | finishLoading completes, `manager.get` succeeds |
